$schema: Gate parity manifest — defines expected checks for each entry point

pr.description: PR-gating checks. Job-level entries are the exact check contexts GitHub reports: each workflow job's `name:` value (or its job id when no name is set), with `${{ matrix.* }}` tokens expanded to their real per-node contexts (e.g. `Lint (Node 22)`). Step names, comments, and other workflow text are never valid evidence for a job check. `external` lists checks published by external GitHub Apps with no workflow file (Codacy).

release.description: Required release readiness checks (release.yml). `checks` are exact job-level check contexts reported by release.yml jobs (matrix-expanded). `readinessJob` names the job that carries the readiness steps; `requiredSteps` are obligations implemented as steps of that job and are validated against its step list only — a comment or step with the same name elsewhere cannot satisfy them.
requiredSteps: Verify tag is on main branch
